text: You've watched the whole series. Now let's build your program.
Step one. Pick your split, from the days you can really train.
Step two. Each day, pick one or two exercises for each movement. A press, a pull, a squat, and a hinge.
Step three. Aim for ten to twenty hard sets per muscle, every week.
Step four. Add a rep, or a little weight, every week. And write it down.
Step five. Every six to eight weeks, take an easier week to recover.
That's it. You now know more than most people in your gym. Save this.
